title: Ribbon output gatekeeper: per-chunk health metrics, callsite span-proxy, and streaming redaction orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Add a lightweight streaming 'ribbon' layer (the gatekeeper) between the API ingress and the renderer that provides: 1) per-chunk health and QoS metrics exposed to Console, 2) a span-proxy that stitches kernel tracing across incremental tool/function calls, and 3) an orchestration point for policy-driven redaction of intermediate streamed payloads. This ticket implements the gatekeeper shim, schema for chunk health events, the span correlation header, and a compatibility adapter for legacy v1 streaming clients.
acceptance_criteria: Ribbon gatekeeper deployed on staging and receiving streaming traffic behind a feature flag
Chunk health events emitted for every partial-output with fields: chunk_id, seq, latency_ms, bytes_out, kv_cache_hit, tool_call_count
Tracing span-proxy creates a parent span per-stream and links incremental tool-call spans using 'x-ribbon-span' header; traces are visible in Stanza with links to per-chunk metrics
Redaction policies can be applied per-stream via `redaction_profile` header and result in zero PII tokens appearing in Console logs or exported traces
Compatibility adapter accepts v1 streaming clients and translates v1 delimited frames into ribbon chunk envelopes without client changes
Unit and integration tests covering edge cases: large prefix cache hits, early stream cancellations, interleaved tool calls, and partial structured outputs
Documentation page in Console docs describing the signal format and how to interpret Ribbon metrics
implementation_notes: Create ribbon/gatekeeper as a sidecar process in the serving runtime; keep it lightweight and non-blocking
Emit metrics to metrics.ingest with tags: model, route, customer_tier, ribbon_instance
Use high-cardinality sampling for 'rare-error' buckets; aggregate histograms for latency at 50/95/99 percentiles
Span-proxy will not modify existing trace ids; it attaches link entries and emits a synthetic parent span when none present
Redaction will run a policy on token windows; policy decisions are logged as opaque hashes in traces instead of raw content
Implement a small compat shim module that detects v1 framing ( prefixed frames) and rewraps into ribbon envelope for downstream
Expose feature-flag `ribbon_gatekeeper_beta` so Dedicated customers can opt-in for early testing
decisions: Decision: implement gatekeeper as sidecar to avoid changing existing runtime hot paths (trade-off: additional deployment complexity vs minimal risk to hot path)
Decision: emit redaction decision hashes instead of raw fragments to preserve observability without exposing PII
Decision: create synthetic parent span only when upstream requests lack a trace header to preserve trace fidelity for instrumented clients
Decision: backward compatibility handled via translator shim rather than forcing client SDK upgrades
